name: Ramp landing page by ramp.com
description: A long, calm fintech landing page built almost entirely from a warm off-white canvas, black editorial typography and a single acid-yellow accent. Hierarchy comes from very large serif-adjacent display headlines alternating with small utility labels, and rhythm shifts from a tight hero with an inline email capture into spacious bento feature cards, a soft photographic testimonial band, then a wide testimonial grid that accelerates density before a minimal email-only CTA and an unusually detailed dark legal footer. Product UI screenshots float on the same cream background with no heavy chrome, letting real interface fragments act as the imagery.
